name: Animal and Alternative Models for Biomedical Research
description:
• Introduction: Role and importance of animal models in biomedical research
• Classification of clinical trials and biomedical solutions.
• Animal models for human disease.
• Selection criteria for choosing an animal model for biomedical device testing
• The ethical implications associated with animal use.
• Database for biomedical animal resources
• Well-established models for different diseases (Yeast, worms, flies, animals, and birds)
• 3Rs principle to reduce, refine, and replace animal models
• Alternative to animal models
• ISO guidelines to conduct preclinical trials with animals, Different tests and analysis that one needs to plan
• Practice and technicalities of animal research
• Preclinical trials: Study design, experimentation and data analysis
